name: Removing knowledge from trained models
gist: These papers explore how to selectively delete information or capabilities from already-trained models—forgetting copyrighted content, removing biased patterns, or erasing harmful behaviors—without breaking the rest of the system.
explain: A trained model has absorbed its training data into its weights. If that data includes copyrighted books, someone might demand you remove them. If the data includes personal information, privacy law might require you to delete it. If the model has learned biased patterns, you might want to remove those behaviors. But the knowledge is distributed across all the weights. You can't just delete one neuron. If you try, you might break other things the model learned. And if you retrain from scratch without that data, it takes time and computational resources. So researchers ask: can you selectively remove knowledge from a trained model without retraining?

Why is this hard? Because machine learning is a many-to-many mapping: different training examples affect many parameters, and each parameter is affected by many training examples. The knowledge you want to remove is woven through the network in complex ways. If you naively delete it, you will likely degrade the model's overall performance or introduce artifacts that users notice. If you try to be surgical, it's hard to know whether you got everything or if the model still retains the knowledge in hidden representations. And you want the model to forget the specific thing while remembering everything else. This is like trying to remove a thread from a sweater without unraveling the whole thing.

Researchers approach unlearning from several angles. One is gradient-based: use optimization techniques to find weight updates that reduce the model's performance on data you want to forget while preserving performance on data you want to keep. Another is to use auxiliary models or classifiers that can distinguish desired from undesired knowledge, then optimize against them. A third is to understand the mechanistic circuits that encode unwanted knowledge and surgically remove them. Some papers also study what constitutes successful unlearning: how do you verify that a model has truly forgotten something and isn't just hiding the knowledge or reproducing it in a different form? The goal is to make machines that can be corrected and updated, rather than requiring complete retraining when something needs to change.

papers.title: ASRU: Activation Steering Meets Reinforcement Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Improve unlearning effectiveness (+24.6%) and generation quality (5.8x) while preserving model utility on Qwen3-VL.

papers.title: Anchored Decoding: Provably Reducing Copyright Risk for Any Language Model
papers.contribution: Preserve near-original fluency while eliminating up to 75% of measurable copying gap between risky and safe models with modest inference overhead.

papers.title: Attention Smoothing Is All You Need For Unlearning
papers.contribution: ASU outperforms baselines on TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP with robust unlearning and minimal utility loss across QA and text completion.

papers.title: Co-occurring Associated REtained concepts in Diffusion Unlearning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art balance of robust concept erasure, overall utility, and CARE preservation across multiple target concepts like nudity and artistic styles.

papers.title: DRAGON: Guard LLM Unlearning in Context via Negative Detection and Reasoning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates strong unlearning capability, scalability, and applicability in practical data-limited scenarios with novel metrics for continual unlearning.

papers.title: ForceForget: Reinforcement Concept Removal for Enhancing Safety in Text-to-Image Models
papers.contribution: Alleviates unsafe content generation while preserving benign image fidelity, with better robustness against red-teaming and effectiveness in image-to-image scenarios.

papers.title: Gaussian certified unlearning in high dimensions: A hypothesis testing approach
papers.contribution: Achieves privacy and accuracy in high-dimensional unlearning with single Newton step, contrasting with prior work requiring two steps, demonstrating improved efficiency in proportional regimes.

papers.title: Influence-Disentangled Federated Training: Learning Models That Are Easy to Unlearn
papers.contribution: IDFT achieves deletion with a single subtraction and short repair, attaining the lowest retrain gap and improving the fidelity-cost frontier on multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: Label Smoothing Improves Machine Unlearning
papers.contribution: Consistently improves unlearning performance over gradient ascent baseline across different tasks and modalities with marginal computational overhead, establishing connections to local differential privacy.

papers.title: Machine Unlearning under Retain–Forget Entanglement
papers.contribution: The proposed method achieves effective and reliable unlearning while outperforming baselines in both accuracy retention and removal fidelity across multiple tasks and architectures.

papers.title: ReTrace: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Reconstruction Attacks on Machine Unlearning
papers.contribution: Achieves 73.1% instance-level recovery and improves reconstruction metrics beyond state-of-the-art, with 100% improvement on text unlearning BLEU scores.

papers.title: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Robust Diffusion Large Language Model Unlearning
papers.contribution: The approach achieves robust unlearning in DLMs by addressing credit assignment and stability issues in adversarial learning, with extended evaluation across diverse generation settings.

papers.title: Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection via Cumulative Entropy
papers.contribution: ABCS mitigates backdooring attacks consistently with negligible impact on natural performance, with public implementation available.

papers.title: Batch and Sequential Unlearning for Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Proposes unlearning algorithms achieving competitive performance in both batch and sequential settings on real-world datasets without manual hyperparameter tuning.

papers.title: Beyond Sample-Level Forgetting: Improving Reliability in Multimodal Unlearning
papers.contribution: Validates effectiveness across privacy and copyright scenarios while ensuring high reliability and locality.

papers.title: Continual Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models: A Regularization Perspective
papers.contribution: Systematic study establishes continual unlearning as a fundamental challenge; gradient-projection regularization substantially improves performance and is complementary to other regularizers.

papers.title: DUET: DISTILLED LLM UNLEARNING FROM AN EFFICIENTLY CONTEXTUALIZED TEACHER
papers.contribution: Achieves significantly higher performance in forgetting and utility preservation while being orders of magnitude more data-efficient than state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title: De-attribute to Forget for LLM Unlearning
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing baseline approaches, achieving effective unlearning while balancing forget quality and model utility through attribution rewards.

papers.title: Decoupling the Class Label and the Target Concept in Machine Unlearning
papers.contribution: Enables targeted forgetting of concepts beyond conventional class-wise unlearning while maintaining other knowledge with systematic analysis of forgetting dynamics.

papers.title: Divergence Decoding: Inference-Time Unlearning via Auxiliary Models
papers.contribution: Decisively outperforms state-of-the-art unlearning baselines and can be distilled back into the base model while generalizing to image domain.

papers.title: Don't Shift the Trigger: Robust Gradient Ascent for Backdoor Unlearning
papers.contribution: RGA effectively removes backdoors while preserving model utility and offers more reliable defense than vanilla gradient ascent.

papers.title: DualOptim+: Bridging Shared and Decoupled Optimizer States for Better Machine Unlearning in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: DualOptim+ consistently achieves superior trade-offs between forgetting and retaining objectives across fictitious, real-world unlearning, safety alignment, and multi-task learning tasks.

papers.title: Erase or Hide? Suppressing Spurious Unlearning Neurons for Robust Unlearning
papers.contribution: Reliably erases target knowledge and outperforms baselines across adversarial injection and instruction-following retraining scenarios.

papers.title: Erased but Not Forgotten: How Backdoors Compromise Concept Erasure
papers.contribution: Demonstrates up to 82% success against celebrity-identity unlearning, up to 94% for object erasure, and up to 16x amplification of explicit-content exposure across six erasure methods.

papers.title: Explainable LLM Unlearning through Reasoning
papers.contribution: TRU achieves more reliable unlearning while preserving general capabilities and demonstrates superior robustness under diverse attack scenarios.

papers.title: Exploring Nonlinear Pathway in Parameter Space for Machine Unlearning
papers.contribution: Uncovers a spectrum of unlearning models along a pathway and consistently improves unlearning efficacy as a plug-and-play framework.

papers.title: FaLW: A Forgetting-aware Loss Reweighting for Long-tailed Unlearning
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance on long-tailed unlearning scenarios.

papers.title: Forget by Uncertainty: Orthogonal Entropy Unlearning for Quantized Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing methods in both forgetting effectiveness and retain accuracy with theoretical guarantees for utility preservation under first-order approximation.

papers.title: Forget to Know, Remember to Use: Context-Aware Unlearning for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Method restores contextual utility to near-original levels while maintaining effective forgetting and utility on retained knowledge.

papers.title: Forget-It-All: Multi-Concept Machine Unlearning via Concept-Aware Neuron Masking
papers.contribution: Achieves more reliable multi-concept unlearning while maintaining generation fidelity with training-free, plug-and-play application.

papers.title: GoodDiffusion: Proactive Copyright Protection for Diffusion Bridge Models via Learnable Sample-specific Signatures
papers.contribution: GoodDiffusion effectively blocks unauthorized use while maintaining generation quality for authorized users, overcoming naive static-signature designs that are vulnerable to surrogate recovery.

papers.title: How Hard Can It Be? Hardness-Aware Multi-Objective Unlearning
papers.contribution: Guarantees specified improvement in forget quality while minimizing retain utility degradation, informing users when both objectives cannot be simultaneously improved.

papers.title: Image Can Bring Your Memory Back: A Novel Multi-Modal Guided Attack against Image Generation Model Unlearning
papers.contribution: RECALL consistently surpasses existing baselines in adversarial effectiveness across ten unlearning methods, revealing critical vulnerabilities in current unlearning pipelines.

papers.title: Knowledge Externalization: Reversible Unlearning and Modular Retrieval in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves effective forgetting while enabling high-fidelity restoration, continuous knowledge editing, and emergent compositionality across multiple memory tokens.

papers.title: LLM Unlearning with LLM Beliefs
papers.contribution: BS-T and BS-S achieve more thorough forgetting while preserving utility better than existing unlearning methods.

papers.title: LMCleaner: Efficient and Certified Online Unlearning via Influence Propagation Truncation
papers.contribution: Achieves over 100x computational savings compared to baselines while maintaining model utility and defending against membership inference attacks.

papers.title: Leak@$k$: Unlearning Does Not Make LLMs Forget Under Probabilistic Decoding
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that only limited forgetting is achieved by SOTA unlearning; leak@k metric provides first large-scale systematic evaluation; RULE achieves no information leakage on TOFU benchmark with many generation samples.

papers.title: Learning-Time Encoding Shapes Unlearning in LLMs
papers.contribution: Learning-time encoding choices significantly impact unlearning effectiveness, providing practical strategies for improving LLM unlearning through encoding-aware design.

papers.title: Leveraging Machine Unlearning for Cost-Efficient Preference Alignment
papers.contribution: Demonstrates cost-efficient preference alignment through selective unlearning of negative examples.

papers.title: Mitigating Privacy Risk via Forget Set-Free Unlearning
papers.contribution: Reload efficiently unlearns on language models using less than 0.025% of retain set and unlearns 7% of model weights in less than 8 minutes on Llama2-7B.

papers.title: Model Collapse Is Not a Bug but a Feature in Machine Unlearning for LLMs
papers.contribution: PMC removes private information from model outputs while preserving general utility and avoids the privacy risk of explicit unlearning target exposure.

papers.title: Multilingual Unlearning in LLMs: Transfer, Dynamics, and Reversibility
papers.contribution: Unlearning transfer is highly variable and language-dependent, and a single inference-time steering direction recovers 50% (Qwen) to 90% (Gemma) of unlearned knowledge, revealing unlearning as superficial suppression.

papers.title: OFMU: OPTIMIZATION-DRIVEN FRAMEWORK FOR MACHINE UNLEARNING
papers.contribution: Achieves better tradeoffs between forgetting efficacy and model utility with provable convergence guarantees under convex and non-convex regimes.

papers.title: Randomized Antipodal Search Done Right for Data Pareto Improvement of LLM Unlearning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms deterministic baselines achieving sublinear complexity and double gain in quality and efficiency across models and datasets.

papers.title: Redirection for Erasing Memory (REM): Towards a universal unlearning method for corrupted data
papers.contribution: Redirection for Erasing Memory performs strongly across diverse unlearning tasks in contrast to prior methods that fail outside their designed regions.

papers.title: Remaining-data-free Machine Unlearning by Suppressing Sample Contribution
papers.contribution: First remaining-data-free unlearning method outperforming state-of-the-art methods that utilize remaining data, eliminating need for data retention.

papers.title: Representation Unlearning: Forgetting through Information Compression
papers.contribution: Achieves more reliable forgetting, better utility retention, and greater computational efficiency than parameter-centric approaches in both zero-shot and full-data settings.

papers.title: Rethinking Benign Relearning: Syntax as the Hidden Driver of Unlearning Failures
papers.contribution: Syntactic diversification effectively suppresses benign relearning, accelerates forgetting, and substantially alleviates the trade-off between unlearning efficacy and model utility.

papers.title: Selective Data Removal for Distributional Machine Unlearning
papers.contribution: Requires 15-82% less deletion than full removal for strong unlearning effects while maintaining model utility, with theoretical guarantees on log-loss bounds.

papers.title: Sharpness-Aware Machine Unlearning
papers.contribution: Sharp MinMax achieves better unlearning performance with decreased feature entanglement, stronger resistance to membership inference attacks, and flatter loss landscapes compared to baseline methods.

papers.title: Tackling Fake Forgetting through Uncertainty Quantification
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superior forgetting quality through effective removal of ground truth labels from conformal prediction sets on image classification tasks.

papers.title: The Forgetting-Retention Dilemma: Certified Unlearning Theory in Continual Learning
papers.contribution: Establishes first theoretical foundation bridging CL and unlearning, revealing trade-offs between preserving historical knowledge and targeted forgetting.

papers.title: Towards Privacy-Guaranteed Label Unlearning in Vertical Federated Learning: Few-Shot Forgetting Without Disclosure
papers.contribution: The method achieves effective label unlearning while maintaining computational efficiency, validated on diverse datasets including MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and medical imaging.

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Certified Decentralized Unlearning via SGD Stability
papers.contribution: Provides certified unlearning with sensitivity bounds for both convex and non-convex loss functions, outperforming baselines on diverse metrics.

papers.title: Unlearning Isn't Deletion: Investigating Reversibility of Machine Unlearning in LLMs
papers.contribution: Exposes gaps in current evaluation methods and identifies that irreversible non-catastrophic forgetting is exceptionally challenging, offering insights for robust erasure algorithms.

papers.title: Unlearning Isn't Invisible: Detecting Unlearning Traces in LLMs from Model Outputs
papers.contribution: Unlearning traces detectable with over 90% accuracy even under forget-irrelevant inputs; larger LLMs exhibit stronger detectability, revealing measurement signatures in activation space.

papers.title: Unlearning Isn’t Forgetting: Revealing Hidden Leakage in Class Unlearning Evaluations
papers.contribution: TREW reduces gap with retrained models by 19% and 46% on CIFAR-10 for U-LiRA and CMIA scores respectively while matching/surpassing existing metrics.

papers.title: Variance-Reduced $(\varepsilon, \delta)-$Unlearning using Forget Set Gradients
papers.contribution: Achieves strictly improved rates with better dependence on achieved error, asymptotically outperforming methods that ignore the forget set in low-error regime.

papers.title: Video Unlearning via Low-Rank Refusal Vector
papers.contribution: Reduces unsafe generations by 36.3% and 58.2% respectively on Open-Sora and ZeroScopeT2V while preserving prompt alignment and video quality.

papers.title: WARP: Weight Teleportation for Attack-Resilient Unlearning Protocols
papers.contribution: WARP reduces adversarial advantage by up to 64% in black-box and 92% in white-box settings across six unlearning algorithms while maintaining retained-data accuracy.

papers.title: Zero-Sacrifice Persistent-Robustness Adversarial Defense for Pre-Trained Encoders
papers.contribution: ZePAD enables single tuning for diverse tasks via branch confidence for DAE detection, enriching feature diversity for simultaneous adversarial robustness and benign preservation.

papers.title: ZeroUnlearn: Few-Shot Knowledge Unlearning in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: ZeroUnlearn outperforms existing baselines in unlearning sensitive inputs while preserving general model utility with few-shot efficiency.
